is_prime[1] = false

    if is_prime[candidate] /\ candidate <= limit / candidate then
        let multiple mut = candidate * candidate

        while multiple <= limit do
            is_prime[multiple] = false
            multiple = multiple + candidate
        od
    fi

spiral() -> Pipe[POSITION] is
    let x mut = 0
    let y mut = 0
    let run mut = 1

    yield (x = x, y = y)

    do
        for step in 0..run do
            x = x + 1

            yield (x = x, y = y)
        od

        for step in 0..run do
            y = y - 1

            yield (x = x, y = y)
        od

        run = run + 1

        for step in 0..run do
            x = x - 1

            yield (x = x, y = y)
        od

        for step in 0..run do
            y = y + 1

            yield (x = x, y = y)
        od

        run = run + 1
    od
